svg.title: The public boundary of DorkOS Cloud
svg.desc: Optional local Cloud clients use HTTPS. Legacy app-side paths coexist with the versioned public contract. The versioned client resolves authenticated instance identity before minting scoped inference credentials under the same current link. A Runs on choice selects credits. Claude Code uses session launch configuration, Codex a separate conversation home, OpenCode a sidecar-wide local relay, and Doe a first-turn inference binding. The token served list gates request formats; the environment variable only disables credits. Managed enrollment and ingress contracts are settled but the consumer remains unwired. The existing tunnel is a separate route to the local server.
